name: verify
description: Check a claim against the evidence it cites. One Choice question returns supports / contradicts / says_nothing.

state_contract.evidence: The source text the claim rests on (string, object, or array).

relation.instructions: How does the evidence relate to the claim?

criteria.supports: The evidence states the claim or directly implies that it is true
criteria.contradicts: The evidence states the opposite of the claim, or implies that it is false
criteria.says_nothing: The evidence does not address what the claim asserts, either way
